design: User-requested retrospective extension after viewing CASE-F01: add positive three-seed mean AUROC to the same TP/FP constraint; not representative or independent confirmation.
eligibility: >=20 total channels, both labels, no EZ minimum. Exclude all four prior cases. DRE mean TP must increase, >=2 seeds increase TP, and three-seed mean AUROC must strictly increase (>1e-12). Do not require all seeds AUROC positive; disclose every seed.
fp_tiers: All three DRE seeds FP change <=0
All three DRE seeds FP change <=2
selection: Same V2 primary order: first nonempty FP tier; maximize DRE mean TP gain, then minimize mean FP change, then maximize equal-weight mean delta AUROC/Recall10, then fixed hash.
implementation: Reuse verified pure Python endpoint/confusion formulas, with original input admission; all640 endpoints/all400 changes must replay unchanged. Original frozen validation thresholds; no training, inference or probability averaging.
privacy: CASE-A01 and CH aliases only outside trusted server; original identity/contact names private.
